about_the_game:
Story Background

A mysterious accident transports you from the real world to a dangerous otherworld. Here, the shadow of the Demon King looms over the land, the Empress has been captured, and the once-invincible royal guards have vanished without a trace. At this critical moment, you, as the only male in this otherworld, have become the last hope for salvation.

However, the countdown to the world’s destruction is only 30 days.

In this solo adventure, you must balance your time and resources, strengthen yourself, and prepare to rescue the Empress. Will you become the hero who saves the world, or will you witness its ultimate demise? The choice is yours!

Game Features

Work System
Work to accumulate funds! As you work more, the rewards increase step by step. Hard work will give you the resources you need for your adventure!

Action Point Decision-Making System
Your action points are limited each day. Carefully allocate your time for working, training, or challenging stages. How you manage each day will determine your success!

Diverse Stat Training
Use money and action points to train and enhance your stats. Strengthen your HP (Health Points), ATK (Attack Power), and DEX (Dexterity) to create a hero tailored to your playstyle!

Stats Affect Combat Performance

  • HP: Increases durability and survivability.

  • ATK: Deals more damage with each hit.

  • DEX: Improves first-strike chances and extends attack and defense operation times.

Semi-Real-Time Combat System
Engage in battles with a unique semi-real-time system:

  • Attack Phase: Swipe your mouse to chain attacks and deal explosive damage.

  • Defense Phase: Enter defense mode and use your mouse to dodge enemy attacks.

Reward Stages with Unique Interactions
Defeat a character to unlock exclusive reward stages! These stages feature unique rhythm-based interaction mechanics. Complete the challenges within the time limit to immerse yourself in the character’s story. You can revisit these moments anytime in the memory log!

Time and Strategy Challenges
The entire game is limited to 30 in-game days. Strategically allocate your resources and plan carefully to conquer all 9 stages, defeat the Demon King, and rescue the Empress. Fail to meet the deadline, and the game will end in failure.

Enhanced with Live2D Technology
To make your adventure more vivid, the game uses Live2D technology, bringing characters and scenes to life for an immersive experience!

Are You Ready to Save the Otherworld?

In this race against time, become the legend of the otherworld!
Join "Swing Hero" now and embark on your heroic journey!
